definitions.explanation: A formal expression indicating that one has no objection or disagreement with a proposal.

examples.japanese: ⟦{全員|ぜんいん}→全員：03310_zenin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{異議|いぎ}なし⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{答|こた}えた→答える：01099_kotaeru⟧。
⟦{議長|ぎちょう}→議長：02681_gichou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧「{異議|いぎ}なし⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{認|みと}めます→認める：02429_mitomeru⟧」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{宣言|せんげん}した→宣言する：21680_sengensuru⟧。
examples.english: The chairperson declared, "No objections are recognized."

examples.japanese: ⟦{提案|ていあん}→提案：03536_teian⟧⟦に{対|たい}して→に対して：06800_nitaishite⟧{異議|いぎ}なし⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がった→上がる：00615_agaru⟧。
examples.english: Voices of agreement rose in response to the proposal.

notes:
⟦{異議|いぎ}→異議：13552_igi⟧ (objection) + なし (none). A formal expression used in meetings, assemblies, and courts to signal agreement with a motion or proposal.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {異議|いぎ}なし⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{認|みと}める→認める：02429_mitomeru⟧: recognize that there are no objections
- {異議|いぎ}なし⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧: voices of agreement
- {異議|いぎ}なし⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{可決|かけつ}→可決：00148_kaketsu⟧: approved without objection
- ⟦{満場|まんじょう}{一致|いっち}→満場一致：28977_manjouicchi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{異議|いぎ}なし: unanimous agreement

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{賛成|さんせい}→賛成：02829_sansei⟧: agreement, approval — the standard word for agreeing, usable in both formal and casual contexts
- ⟦{了承|りょうしょう}→了承：11415_ryoushou⟧: consent, acceptance — implies understanding and accepting rather than just not objecting
- ⟦{異議|いぎ}→異議：13552_igi⟧あり: objection — the opposite, used to register a formal objection

USAGE:
Primarily used in formal settings such as parliamentary proceedings, board meetings, and courtroom scenes. In the Japanese Diet, members call out {異議|いぎ}なし to approve motions. Also well known from courtroom dramas and the video game series Ace Attorney ({逆転裁判|ぎゃくてんさいばん}).
